title: The Bishop Interposes for You
setup: Black has a queen on f4 and rooks on a4 and a2 aimed at your king on b5 — the threats are everywhere.
hint: Find the check that Black can only meet by putting its strongest piece in the way.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bg8+}} forces {{Qf7}}, because nothing else blocks, and {{Bxf7#}} takes the queen and the game together. A check that demands a specific block is worth more than a check that merely annoys.
